title: A formula of counting divisors in integers rings: a generalization of the divisor function $d_0(n)$
summary: In this paper we establish a formal connection between the structure of ideals in integers rings and the theory of additive combinatorics. For integers rings with cyclic class groups, we prove a structural theorem demonstrating that every non-zero ideal can be decomposed into a maximal principal part and a product of ideals whose total length is bounded by the Davenport constant. With this decomposition we find divisors for generators of the ideal $I=(α, β)$.
